notes: Schedule 1 (Form 1040) line 7 for the bounded 2025 class: equals the closed Form 1099-G box-1 family subtotal. Box-1 family closure alone never asserts general Schedule 1 completeness. Box 4 withholding is not part of this line: earlier packages enforce an absent-or-zero box-4 companion at admission, and from core v59 the box-4 amount is recorded in its own family and reaches Form 1040 line 25b only. Does not implement repayment arithmetic. Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 1): the subtotal it reads now carries cents, so this line rounds it once with the rounding convention. A whole-dollar subtotal gives the same value as before.
